name: mac-menu-popover
title: Mac menu popover
description: An animated macOS menu bar popover for React and shadcn, for Tauri and Electron apps.

meta.details: A macOS menu bar popover: a status item and a frosted panel whose arrow and panel are one shape, so one blur and one hairline follow the arrow. It grows from the arrow tip, reverses mid-flight, and drops its CSS blur for native Tauri or Electron vibrancy.

docs: Import MacMenuPopover, MacStatusItem, MacMenuPopoverContent, MacMenuItem and MacMenuSeparator from components/eased/mac-menu-popover/mac-menu-popover. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. Put MacStatusItem (with a label) and MacMenuPopoverContent inside MacMenuPopover, and wrap rows that should close the panel in MacMenuPopoverClose. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark". In a Tauri or Electron tray window, render MacMenuPanel instead; it defaults to material="native" (a CSS blur cannot see the desktop there). Keep html and body transparent and call useSystemAppearance() from components/eased/lib/mac so dark follows the system.
